title: The retire-ledger story, under the operator's delegated authority; ledger-as-view ends dropped
situation: The operator asked to retire the ledger, granting delegated authority over it: its one kept sign-off is its review of the change before it joins dev; every other sign-off on it is taken by whoever holds that gate. The ledger-as-view story, which turned the ledger into a view, was in flight and never joined.
decision: (1) The retire-ledger story is the deletion of the ledger, its end state that cratylus keeps no ledger and the check passes. (2) Its read-back is signed off by the architect in the operator's place: the design serves the intent as stated, and the change is a deletion, so nothing in it waits on a value only the operator holds. Its plan read-back is the lead's to take. (3) Review is Ask, with the operator's own review before the change joins dev as its gate, held by the lead. (4) The ledger-as-view story ends dropped: with no ledger its slice is no longer wanted, and nothing of it joins.
consequences: The lead realizes the story from dev and hands over its outcome; the operator's review of the change is the one interrupt.
